description: Implement enhanced error management system with centralized error handling, logging, and improved API error handling. This builds on the existing api.ts error handling but adds comprehensive error categorization, logging, and integration with the notification system. The current API client has basic error handling but needs better error types and user feedback.
steps: Create src/lib/error-types.ts with comprehensive error type definitions (network, authentication, validation, permission, server errors) extending current API error patterns
Create src/lib/error-handler.ts with centralized ErrorHandler class for categorizing, logging, and managing all application errors
Create src/lib/error-logger.ts for client-side error logging with structured logging and optional backend reporting
Create src/hooks/useErrorHandler.ts custom hook for components to easily handle and display errors with integration to existing toast system
Enhance src/lib/api.ts to use new error management system, improving existing axios interceptors with better error categorization and user feedback
Update API error handling to integrate with existing NotificationContext for consistent user notifications across all API calls
acceptance_criteria: All application errors are properly categorized and handled consistently
API errors provide user-friendly messages instead of raw server responses
Error logging captures sufficient context for debugging without exposing sensitive data
Components can easily handle errors using useErrorHandler hook with minimal boilerplate
Error handling integrates seamlessly with existing NotificationContext toast system
Network errors, authentication failures, and server errors show appropriate user guidance
verification: npm run build compiles successfully with new error management system
npm run type-check passes with proper TypeScript typing for all error types
Manual testing: Simulate network errors, verify user sees appropriate messages and recovery options
Manual testing: Test API errors (401, 403, 500) to ensure proper categorization and user feedback
Verify error logging works without exposing sensitive information in console or logs
